title: Comment on the Agents page "Agents": Why agent didn't appear on this ?

messages.text: Why agent didn't appear on this ?

Fixed for now: the page shows the working team agents again (Running now: 3, finished ones listed with what they did).
- Cause: the page counts an agent as running only when it holds Chrome or the phone, runs a wait, or owns a fresh status-board row.
- The lessons team (T-275) only reads files and messages each other, so it had none of these; my spawn prompts forgot to give them rows.
- Now: each of the 7 agents has a row; writer and reviewer show as running and update their rows; the 5 readers show as done.
- Long term (incident I-265): the page should also see live Claude Code team agents directly, even without a row; a toolsmith can do it.
- I will give every new helper a status row at spawn from now on.
What you need to do: nothing; say if you want I-265 fixed now.
Is it not automatable from observe the claude code ?

Yes, it can be automatic, and a tooling agent (ts-I-265) is building it now.
- Claude Code already writes down every team agent: its name, its team, and a log it adds to at each step.
- The Agents page will read that: an agent that did something in the last few minutes shows as running; a quiet team agent shows as waiting for messages.
- Then no status row is needed for an agent to appear; rows still say what it works on.
- It comes with tests, and I add it to the console once they pass; I will tell you here.
What you need to do: nothing.

Done: the Agents page now finds team agents by itself, from Claude Code's own records (fix I-265, live now).
- Running now shows 12: agents working, plus team agents idle between steps (they wake on a message).
- No status row needed any more; rows still add what an agent works on.
- Checked: full test suite on main 2525 of 2525 passed; console restarted to load it.
- Side find (I-266): today's Mac developer-tools update broke one test's C compile; a setting works around it, no action needed now.
What you need to do: nothing; reload the Agents page to see it.
